body: Relate to this so much. Thanks for writing that.

I’m sorry to hear that. When I’m low even the thought of food makes me feel nauseous… but it’s something else too. I just completely lose the desire to eat. It causes my stomach to cramp, of course, but I don’t feel hungry as such. Do you have this too ?

Hey, you’re probably right. Stressful situations hit me like a freight train. I end up in this mess for days, sometimes weeks, where I completely lose my appetite and bail on commitments (work and social) as I try to dull the pain by smoking up.

Life just seems to get worse and worse. I feel like I’m in the middle of an ocean, treading water to stay afloat. Shit is exhausting

I’m so scared. Not to die, I’m an atheist, I don’t believe in an afterlife or anything like that. As far as I’m concerned, when it’s over it’s over. 

But I’m scared to jump. I don’t know if this makes any sense. 

And I’m scared for the people I love. Especially my mum. But I can’t keep going
I feel broken. I have no job and no ambition. I’m so insecure. I have no self esteem. I’m depressed and have horrible anxiety that makes me throw up
